concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-customer-search-node]] - Node.js customer search through `gateway.customer.search()`, with callback `response.each()` consumption, raw routes for filter examples and operator restrictions, the preserved results-limitation notice, and the unavailable all-customers Node call
warnings: Retain the PayPal Data Protection Addendum notice without interpreting the unread external policy or specifying which results or fields are limited.
Keep the all-customers section's current-cap warning and explicit Node non-implementation together; do not imply that Node can enumerate every Vault customer.
Treat the linked Search fields, Search results, and Customer response pages as navigation only; this source does not establish their unread schemas or an exhaustive filter/operator inventory.
Keep this source scoped to Node customer search; do not generalize its filter syntax or result consumption to transaction, subscription, or credit-card-verification search.
